# newreleases_microsoft_teams_webhooks (Data Source)

Lists Microsoft Teams webhooks configured in the account. Use their IDs in `newreleases_project.microsoft_teams_webhooks`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "newreleases_microsoft_teams_webhooks" "all" {}
```
